mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.8% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift toward risk-off behavior and negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.8%, or the signal fails to generate a negative return distribution (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which drives corporate earnings expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and triggers negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 103.0, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and housing demand, which boosts corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 242.0 over two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which leads to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during CPIAUCSL > 242.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.6% and a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 145,000 thousand signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE < 4.6% and PAYEMS > 145000 fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a stable or rising CPI (CPIAUCSL), indicates a strong and inflationary expansion, which leads to higher interest rate expectations and negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL fails to generate negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
